research_notes.finding: Pattern: Use ToolCallManager.addToolCallChunk(chunk) to accumulate streaming tool call chunks. After stream completes, check manager.hasToolCalls() and execute via yield* manager.executeTools(doneChunk).

StreamChunk types include: content, tool_call, tool_result, done. Tool call chunks may arrive in fragments - arguments streamed incrementally. Server-side tools auto-execute; client-side tools send tool-input-available chunk. TanStack AI ChatClient automatically handles client tool execution on approval.

useAgentChatWithTools already extracts pendingApprovals from rawMessages parts with state === 'approval-requested' and approval.id. This covers single approvals. Batch detection (multiple tools in one response) not yet implemented.

architecture_patterns.pattern: User message → /api/chat → SSE stream → ToolCallManager accumulates chunks → Complete tool call triggers approval-requested state → UI shows ApprovalOverlay → User approves → addToolApprovalResponse({id, approved}) → Tool executes → tool_result added → Chat continues
UI Component (ApprovalOverlay) → Zustand store → Hook state → EventBus → File tree / editor updates
